name: Realization
detailed_description:
In 2022, in the fictional realm of Nantang Village in the NanTu District, a fire broke out at the sales center of a residential project called The Inner Paradise, This tragic incident leads to the mysterious death of a female sales agent, and the true culprit aims to pin the crime on Kalin Liu, a female agent who happened to be at the scene. From the moment she stepped into the sales center, her reality began to crumble.

A desperate real estate agent at her wit's end

Once awarded Best Salesperson, real estate agent Kalin Liu sees the Inner Paradise project as her shot at redemption in this treacherous market. However, the halt in construction has shaken her confidence. On the night of a shocking arson incident, she receives a mysterious call. The sales agent she was supposed to meet, Sindy Li, has been found dead at the construction site. She begins to realize that her every move seems to be under surveillance. How much deeper will this nightmare drag her into darkness? She doesn't know, but if she hopes to survive, she'll need more than just her wits.

A self-built apartment that’s always under renovation

Within the planned development area of the new residential complex in Nantang Village, there are still some disputed and ambiguous plots. A few villagers show no signs of relocating. Building No. 9, located at the end of the street, is a five-story self-built structure where rooms are being rented out as self-contained apartments, and the sounds of ongoing renovations can occasionally be heard from within. Real estate agent Kalin Liu is currently renting one of those rooms.

A chilling narrative experience set in an absurd society.

Realization is the first horror visual novel from Agaze Productions, inspired by the specific dilemmas and criminal psychology that emerge in modern society. The game will be released across 7 episodes. Episodes 1: The Roughscape of Belief are available now for you to play, the remaining episodes will be added as free updates once they're complete.

Features:

■ Immerse yourself in a world crafted by rich branching narratives and surreal animated illustrations

■ Decide the fate of characters in ‘Choose Your Own Adventure’style gameplay

■ The branching storylines present varied experiences, reflecting the characters' unique dilemmas, actions, and mental states

■ Puzzles emerge in both realistic and surreal forms throughout different branches, where even death carries its own special significance

short_description: A self-staged arson at a sales center drags you into the murder case of a female sales agent. With both your career and life in shambles, you must find a way to clear your name. The path to the truth is fraught with danger. Can you rise from this abyss and reclaim the reality you once envisioned?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD R5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5700 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i9 or AMD R9
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
